*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Destroyer of Spheres (Su):** A blacksword breaker becomes a mid-casterSoP, gains a spell pool and uses Wisdom as their casting attribute, and gains the destruction and telekinesis spheres plus the energy strike talent as their starting talents. They also must have their mindblade summoned to use their spherecasting. If this is the character’s first martial class they also gain a martial tradition.

These abilities replace psychic strike and the bonus feat gained at 1st level.

**Skills of Destruction (Su):** The blacksword breaker can select martial and magical spheres and talents from both the Spheres systems instead of a blade skill. Additionally, they may use their psionic focus as though it was martial focus for martial sphere effects. They may choose to take blade skills as normal.

This alters blade skill.

**Multiwield (Su):** At 5th level, when using the destruction sphere for area effects, the blacksword breaker can pay 1 additional spell point to choose to manifest thrown mind blades targeting any target in the area and may make an attack roll as part of the area of effect. If the attack hits any creature in the area they take mind blade damage in addition to the destruction effect and take a penalty to any Reflex save against the effect equal to the mind blade enhancement bonus. If the attack roll misses against that creature they automatically succeed any Reflex save for the area attack.

This replaces quick draw.

# New Bladeskill

#### Entropic Power (Su)

Any enhancement bonus from your mind blade can instead be applied as a bonus to any of your caster or manifester levels for effects that deal damage instead of to hit and damage. You may choose which effect the bonus has as a free action once per turn.
